display_long_description:
In this free multiplayer social game, you play as a bear scout hanging out at camp with your friends! 🐻

**Take care of the camp** 🔥

Gather wood around the forest to keep the campfire burning and enjoy grilled marshmallows under the stars, then help keep the camp clean by picking up any trash you find along the way!

[media]

**Fish in the lake** 🐟


From tiny fish to massive sharks, you never know what you’ll catch in these mysterious waters...

[media]

**Hang with your friends** 🌲

The forest has everything you need! From climbing wild parkours to crazy dance battles on the dancefloor, there’s always something fun to do with your friends!

[media]

**Customize your bear** 🎩

Pick up your favorite hat and show it to your friend!

[media]

New updates are coming soon bears! Stay tuned and in the meantime **join us on discord** : https://discord.gg/qDc94fFRE9
